sentences.text:
1 THE FOLLOWING:
 LA.APP.NO.363 OF 2018 2  2025:KER:9907  JUDGMENT

Dated this the 6th day of February, 2025 This appeal is filed challenging the judgment and decree dated 25.08.2016 in L.A.R.No.361 of 2013 of the Subordinate Judge's Court, Thalassery.
2.
An extent of 0.0202 hectares of land (4.99 cents) comprised in Re.Sy.No.33/3 of Elambara Desom in Keezhallur Village of Thalassery Taluk was acquired for the purpose of Kannur Airport at Mattannur.
Notification under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act was issued on 19.03.2010.
The Land Acquisition Officer had awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.13,710/- per cent.
In the Land Acquisition Reference preferred by the appellant, the same was increased by the reference court to Rs.20,000/- per cent.

Seeking further enhancement, the appellant has filed the above L.A.A.
3.
Heard Sri.Binoy Ram V., Advocate, for the appellant and Smt.Rekha C.Nair for the 1 st respondent and Sri.P.U.Shailajan, learned Standing Counsel for the 2nd respondent.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that with respect to similarly situated land in the very same village, which was acquired for the very same purpose, a Division Bench of this Court had enhanced the land value to Rs.45,775/- per cent.
It is contended by the appellant that he is also entitled to the very same enhancement.
A copy of the said judgment dated 16.01.2025 of the Division Bench in L.A.A.No.180 of 2019 is handed over to me for perusal.
It is noted that the land acquired therein was for the very same purpose and is situated in the very same village.

5. It is trite as reiterated by the Supreme Court in Mohammed Raofuddin v. Land Acquisition Officer [(2009) 14 SCC 367] that judgments and awards passed in respect of the acquisition of lands made in the same village and/or neighbouring villages can be accepted as valid pieces of evidence and they provide a sound basis to determine the market value of the land after suitable adjustments with regard to positive and negative factors and with some amount of guesswork.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. The acquired land of the appellant in this L.A.A. is situated in the very same village and had been acquired for the very 2025:KER:9907 same purpose of the Kannur Airport at Mattannur as the land covered by the judgment dated 16.01.2025 of the Division Bench in L.A.A.No.180 of 2019.

The appellant is thus entitled to a land value at the same rate per cent as refixed by this Court in the said L.A.A.

sentences.text: Hence, this appeal is allowed to the above extent.
The land value awarded in L.A.R.No.361 of 2013 of the Subordinate Court, Thalassery, is revised to Rs.45,775/- per cent commensurate to the extent of land acquired from the appellant.

The appellant will be entitled to all statutory benefits as admissible in law less the interest for 643 days taking note of the delay that had occasioned in filing this L.A.A., as noted by this Court in the order dated 07.12.2021.
L.A.A. is allowed as above.

Sd/-
